questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are 4 cm, 6 cm and 10 cm respectively. Find the total surface area.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are 4 cm, 6 cm and 10 cm respectively

**Formula used:**

The total surface area = 2(lb + bh + lh) (length = l, breadth = b and height = h)

**Calculation :**

As per the question,

The total surface area ,

⇒ 2(4 × 6 +6 × 10 +4 × 10 ) 

⇒ 2(124 ) = 248 cm2

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question:
A = Rs. 6000 is invested at simple interest for 5 years and annual rate of interest is 15 percent.

B = Rs. 5000 is invested at simple interest for 2 years and annual rate of interest is 20 percent.

What is the ratio of interests earned in A and B respectively?
questions.solution:
Given:

Simple interest on a sum for eight months at the rate of 8 percent per annum is Rs. 240

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

A received simple interest is,

⇒ 6000 × 15 × 5 / 100 = Rs 4500

B received simple interest is,

⇒ 5000 × 20 × 2 / 100 = Rs 2000

The ratio of interests earned in A and B respectively,

⇒ 4500 : 2000 = 9 : 4

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: The Least Common Multiple of thee different numbers is 40. Which of the following cannot be their Highest Common Factor?
questions.solution:

The Least Common Multiple of thee different numbers is 40.

**Concept used:**

If we factories the LCM , we must get the HCF

**Calculation:**

So among the factors 5 , 10 and 20 are the factors of 40.

25 is not any factor of 40

**So, 25 cannot be their Highest Common Factor**

questions.question: The average of marks obtained by S1 and S2 is 30 more than the average marks obtained by S2 and S3. If the marks obtained by S3 is 50, then what are the marks obtained by S1?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of marks obtained by S1 and S2 is 30 more than the average marks obtained by S2 and S3. 

The marks obtained by S3 is 50

**Calculation:**

Let the marks obtained by S1 = x

As per the question,

⇒ {(x +S2)over2}-{(S2 + 50)over2} = 30

⇒ x + S2 - S2 - 50 = 60

⇒ x = 110

**∴ The correct option is** 4

questions.question: An item is sold at two successive discounts of 20 percent and 20 percent. The selling price of article after second discount is Rs. 3616. If it is sold only at one discount of 20 percent, then what will be the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
Given:

An item is sold at two successive discounts of 20 percent and 20 percent. The selling price of article after second discount is Rs. 3616. If it is sold only at one discount of 20 percent

Formula Used:

Single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of a % and b %

= (a + b - (ab)/(100))% 

 

Calculation:

Here, a = 20% , and b = 20 %

So, the single discount gets, (20 + 20 - 20 × 20/100) %

⇒ (40 - 4) %

⇒ 36 %

After getting discount of 36 % , he has to pay 64%

As per the question,

Value of 64% = 3616

Again, After getting discount of 20 % , he has to pay 80%

So value of 80% is ,

⇒ (3616 / 64) × 80 = Rs 4520

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: A certain sum of money becomes triple of itself in 8 years at simple interest. In how many years it will becomes five times of itself?
questions.solution:
Given:

A certain sum of money becomes triple of itself in 8 years at simple interest. 

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

Let, P = principal.

The simple interest will be 3P - P = 2P

⇒ 2P = P × R × 8 / 100

⇒ R = 25%

Again the money will be 5 times 

The simple interest will be 5P - P = 4P

⇒ 4P = P × 25 × T / 100

⇒ T = 16 years

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: A trader buys two articles for Rs. 4000 each article. If he earns a profit of 10 percent on one and losses 30 percent on the other, then what will be his overall loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A trader buys two articles for Rs. 4000 each article.

He earns a profit of 10 percent on one and losses 30 percent on the other.

**Concept used:**

Selling price = cost price + profit 

Selling price = cost price - loss

**Calculation:**

Total cost price is 4000 +4000 = Rs 8000

The profit amount is 4000× 10/100 = Rs 400

The profit amount is 4000× 30/100 = Rs 1200

Total loss amount is 1200 - 400 = Rs 800

Loss percentage is (800/8000) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct option is** 1
